view.hierarchy.noActiveDefinition: Open a Scene or Entity to view its hierarchy.
configuration.authoring.javaExecutable: Java executable used to launch the development authoring service. The JSCENE3D_JAVA_EXECUTABLE environment variable takes precedence.
configuration.authoring.modulePath: Development JPMS module path containing the JScene3D authoring service and its dependencies. The JSCENE3D_AUTHORING_SERVICE_MODULE_PATH environment variable takes precedence. Production service discovery is not yet implemented.
configuration.authoring.installedExtensi: Ordered paths to installed descriptor-only extension metadata artifacts or directories. The path-list value in JSCENE3D_AUTHORING_EXTENSION_METADATA_PATH takes precedence. These paths are separate from the Java module path and are never used to execute runtime extension providers.
configuration.authoring.runtimeArtifacts: Ordered absolute JAR paths made available only to isolated project viewport renderer processes. The path-list value in JSCENE3D_PROJECT_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_PATH takes precedence.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.altDr: Enable Option/Alt + primary-button drag to orbit the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.shift: Enable Shift + Option/Alt + primary-button drag to pan the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.middl: Enable middle-button drag to pan the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.scrol: Enable mouse-wheel and two-finger scrolling to zoom the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.pinch: Enable trackpad pinch gestures to zoom the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.navigation.altRi: Enable Option/Alt + secondary-button vertical drag to zoom the Scene View editor camera.
configuration.sceneView.transform.transl: Translation snap increment used by the Scene View Move tool.
configuration.sceneView.transform.rotati: Rotation snap increment in degrees used by the Scene View Rotate tool.
configuration.sceneView.transform.scaleS: Scale snap increment used by the Scene View Scale tool.
